cli_controls: all execution requires matching frozen plan SHA-256
connected: Historical connected association via committed staged connected branch; no compact family or sidecar.
development_test_corrections: Initial connected comparison included intentionally omitted expanded-payload placeholders; corrected to compare all scientific fields.
Initial sidecar outcome lacked required process_peak_rss_kib; corrected and roundtrip tests pass.

dispatch.selection: Scientific association setting, candidate structure and runtime certificates only; no identity/outcome dispatch

dispatch_proof: Adapter receives no case identifier or expected outcome.
Exact counter is the identical corrected regression function accepting family and budget only.
Committed structural certificates and exact fallbacks share frozen budgets.
Identity relabeling test preserves backend, dispatch and exact count.
execution_control: verified complete arms skipped on resume
failures and incomplete arms stop resume
no automatic retries or limit escalation

integrity.baseline_inventory: All original 3079 paths/hashes embedded in launch-plan sources.

limitations: Review readiness is not execution authorization.
Full-matrix performance/outcomes remain unmeasured; frozen bounds can produce preserved unresolved arms.
RSS ceiling is observed polling plus final successful-worker high-water mark.
Future final scientific acceptance must separately consider frozen fixture failures; this runner makes no acceptance claim.
scientific_binding: original fragment denominator and candidate identities
scope: 160 real-data matrix arms. Shared historical synthetic and association-fixture evidence remains frozen; no new experiment acceptance decision.
self_hash_policy: Report intentionally excludes its own hash; all referenced artifacts and sources are independently checked.
